notes.title: Big Update!
notes.notes:
We have just made a big update for Unfair Jousting Fair:
[list]
[*]New Singleplayer Arcade mode where you must face all the characters, one after another.
[*]New characters: we added the two main characters from AlPixel Games' [url=store.steampowered.com/app/395520/]Missing Translation[/url] as playable characters.
[*]New game modes: some of the old game modes that were selectable through activation/deactivation of objects are now selectable from the game menu, and there are some new modes, like olympic and street jousting.
[*]New music, for the new modes!
[*]And more fun!
[/list]

notes.title: Gamepad support has been fixed!
notes.notes: Thanks to your comments, we noticed an issue with gamepad control in the menus (and by "issue" we mean "it wasn't working at all"). We have just released a patch that (hopefully) fixes that. Enjoy!
